$comment: Solution Wizard dropdown rules, applied to random picks by src/automation/wizard-rules.ts. A rule limits the dropdown whose label matches 'field' (regex, any case), when 'when' holds (another dropdown's pick names one of 'products'). 'only' keeps those products, 'exclude' removes them, 'prefer' picks among them when offered. Products are the part numbers in brackets at the start of an option, e.g. '(R4U33A) HPE Alletra 5010'.

ruleSets.name: HPE Alletra 5000
ruleSets.source: OCA rule source Alletra5000Solution (essn.storage.network.nimblestorage.alletra5000), shared by the user 2026-11-03. Base arrays: 5010 = R4U33A, R7L31A; 5010H = S0U33A, S1D81A; 5030 = R4U34A, R7L32A; 5050 = R4U35A, R7L33A.

5030/5050: cache S0U36A is supported on 5010H only (rule3_SupportCache)
Cache R8F35A is not supported with HDD Capacity R4U43A (cacheSupport_HDD_R4U43A)

Bank A R4U47A: Bank B R8F35A, R4U47A or R4U48A (BankAandB_rule2)
